name: Nysa
source:
The hot-headed, hammer-swinging titan Nysa travels the cosmic spaces between realms, repairing damaged supernatural tethers. She is quick to anger but quick to forgive as well and can be loving and protective of those she cares about, such as Penelope and their tortoise, Anvy.

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
